prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished comparison board of THREE subtle right-edge website navigation/scroll-control ideas for 8x Social. Input image 1 is the actual approved live hero screenshot; preserve the carbon #111111 background, typography, five monochrome portraits, orange circle, cream text, proportions and softly feathered screen-edge halftone. This is a side-control design proposal, NOT a hero redesign.
Board layout: large high-resolution landscape editorial presentation on warm stone #e9e5dc. Three equal columns labelled “01 / SCROLL THREAD”, “02 / CHAPTER DOTS”, “03 / QUIET INDEX”. Each column shows the SAME full desktop hero screenshot in a wide miniature, then below a much larger close-up of just the right edge showing its distinct proposed control, then a concise motion sentence. Keep all page content and faces recognizable and unchanged. Controls are narrow, elegant, extremely restrained and aligned to physical right viewport, outside text/image composition. In enlarged details include enough of the black hero, subtle dot background and a sliver of the orange circle to show context.
01 SCROLL THREAD: recommended quietest. A hairline muted grey vertical track near right viewport edge, a short warm-orange progress segment, one tiny orange circular handle at end. No pill background or labels. Caption “A quiet line follows your scroll.”
02 CHAPTER DOTS: five tiny vertical round dots with generous spacing. Inactive muted warm grey; active orange dot with delicate thin open ring. On hover a single small cream label “The network” appears to its left; no card. Show a faint curved arrow in the presentation annotation only, indicating gentle active-ring expansion. Caption “A small signal for each chapter.”
03 QUIET INDEX: a compact typographic marker on right edge “01 / 06” above a short thin orange horizontal dash; on hover expands left into three understated labels “The network”, “How it works”, “Our markets”, active one cream and others dimgrey. No floating pill, no heavy rail, no large numbers. Caption “Section names appear when needed.”
Keep proposed controls ACTUAL small scale inside full-hero previews, enlarged separately below so viewer can see. Only orange accent, carbon, warm cream. No neon, no gradients on controls, no glassmorphism, no app dashboard, no added UI chrome, no border enclosing portraits, no invented logos. Beautiful crisp typographic grid, excellent spacing and restraint. Top board title “A quieter way through.” Small board note “Three side-control concepts · shown enlarged below”.
